mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DANGER_NOTICE (NOTICE_CONTENT, NOTICE_CATEGORY, FARM_NUM) VALUES (#{noticeContent}, #{noticeCategory}, #{farmNum})
mapper.select: SELECT NOTICE_NUM as noticeNum, NOTICE_CONTENT as noticeContent, NOTICE_CATEGORY as noticeCategory, FARM_NUM as farmNum, REC_TIME as recTime FROM ( SELECT t1.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.NOTICE_CATEGORY, DATE_FORMAT(t1.REC_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY t1.REC_TIME ASC ) as rn FROM DANGER_NOTICE t1 WHERE t1.FARM_NUM = #{farmNum} ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY REC_TIME DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT DATE(REC_TIME) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM DANGER_NOTICE WHERE FARM_NUM = #{farmNum} AND DATE(REC_TIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(REC_TIME) ORDER BY date DESC
